text: {"name":"get_channel_entry_code","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns zero if the entry marker at offset 113 is 0xFF or the gate at offset 132 is zero; otherwise returns the 8-bit value 13 times the byte at offset 136 plus 11.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"a1":"entry_index","v1":"entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":113,"meaning":"Entry marker; 0xFF causes the entry to be rejected."},{"offset":132,"meaning":"Nonzero gate required to produce a code."},{"offset":136,"meaning":"Byte transformed into the returned code as 13*x+11."}]}
